notes: Account: UK-based regtech provider; product used by banks and regulators for retrospective compliance search.
Primary ask: low-latency enterprise search across 100M+ documents with strong UK/EU residency and audit trail.
Workload profile: high read-heavy search, bursts around end-of-day reporting windows; typical QPS target 1.5k-3k during peaks; avg queries/day target for POC: 50k.
Indexing scale: planning for 120M documents (policy records, email archives, filings). Concerned about vector index sharding and storage cost.
Search stack desired: dense embeddings for recall + lightweight reranker for precision (top-50 -> rerank to top-5). They want deterministic rerank latency p50 < 30ms, p95 < 120ms.
Latency requirements: EU-only interactive queries should be <50ms regional RTT for initial vector search; end-to-end (query + rerank) p95 target 200ms.
Cost sensitivity: procurement wants guidance on cost/query with Dedicated vs Private; target effective cost per query <= $0.0008 (embeddings + rerank amortized).
Model preferences: open-models preferred for auditability; customer evaluating quantized Llama-family reranker + smaller embedding model. Interested in Redwood-recommended quantization profiles.
Routing/failover: strict UK residency for primary; read-failover to EU-DE region only under capacity emergency. Need multi-region routing policy and audit trail for data movement.
Security: mandatory SSO (SAML), KMS integration, full audit logging and 7-year retention for event logs (per regulator ask).
Quote from CTO on call: "We cannot risk cross-border processing without explicit legal path — any fallback must be auditable and pre-approved."
AE notes: strong enterprise procurement timeline Q2; technical champions in search infra and security teams.
POC ask: ingest 20M doc subset, run 2-week live traffic sim with synthetic bursts, measure p99 latency and cost profile.
